select IFNULL(COUNT(*),0) FROM tb_screen_sum s LEFT JOIN tb_screen_collect c on s.collect_id=c.id LEFT JOIN tb_screen_ppd p on s.ppd_id=p.id LEFT JOIN tb_screen_chest_radiograph r on s.chest_radiograph_id=r.id LEFT JOIN tb_screen_computed_tomography t on s.computed_tomography_id=t.id WHERE ( (c.outcome <> 0 and QUARTER(s.last_ppd_time)=#{quarter}) or (p.outcome = 1 and QUARTER(s.last_ppd_time)=#{quarter}) or( t.outcome <> 0 and QUARTER(s.last_computed_tomography_time)=#{quarter}) or( r.outcome <>0 and QUARTER(s.last_chest_radiograph_time)=#{quarter}) ) and s.year=#{year} and s.person_id in
#{personId}

SELECT tsd.name AS districtName, sd.name AS schoolName, tsp.student_type AS studentType, COUNT(tsp.id) AS actualStudentNumber, COUNT(CASE WHEN latest_ppd.injection = 1 THEN 1 END) AS ppdNumber, COUNT(CASE WHEN latest_ppd.maxScreenOrder > 1 THEN 1 END) AS ppdReNumber, COUNT(CASE WHEN latest_ppd.outcome = 0 THEN 1 END) AS feminine, COUNT(CASE WHEN latest_ppd.outcome = 1 THEN 1 END) AS masculine, COUNT(CASE WHEN tss.ppd_id IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS noPpdNumber, COUNT(CASE WHEN latest_collect.outcome IS NOT NULL OR latest_collect.contacted = 1 THEN 1 END) AS symptomsNumber, COUNT( latest_chest_radiograph.id_num) AS sumXrayNumber, COUNT(CASE WHEN latest_chest_radiograph.outcome = 0 THEN 1 END) AS normalXrayNumber, COUNT(CASE WHEN latest_chest_radiograph.outcome != 0 THEN 1 END) AS abnormalXrayNumber FROM tb_screen_person AS tsp LEFT JOIN system_dept AS sd ON sd.id = tsp.dept_id LEFT JOIN tb_screen_district AS tsd ON tsd.CODE = sd.district_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT id_num, injection, outcome, screen_type, screen_order AS maxScreenOrder FROM tb_screen_ppd WHERE year = #{year} GROUP BY id_num, injection, outcome, screen_type, screen_order ORDER BY maxScreenOrder DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_ppd ON tsp.id_num = latest_ppd.id_num AND tsp.screen_type = latest_ppd.screen_type LEFT JOIN (SELECT id_num, screen_type, outcome, contacted, screen_order FROM tb_screen_collect WHERE year = #{year} GROUP BY id_num, screen_type, outcome, contacted, screen_order ORDER BY screen_order DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_collect ON tsp.id_num = latest_collect.id_num AND tsp.screen_type = latest_collect.screen_type LEFT JOIN (SELECT id_num, outcome, screen_type, screen_order FROM tb_screen_chest_radiograph WHERE year = #{year} GROUP BY id_num, outcome, screen_type, screen_order ORDER BY screen_order DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_chest_radiograph ON tsp.id_num = latest_chest_radiograph.id_num AND tsp.screen_type = latest_chest_radiograph.screen_type LEFT JOIN (SELECT id_num, screen_type, ppd_id FROM tb_screen_sum WHERE year = #{year} GROUP BY id_num, ppd_id, screen_type) AS tss ON tsp.id_num = tss.id_num AND tsp.screen_type = tss.screen_type WHERE tsp.year = #{year} AND tsp.student_type != 0 AND sd.district_code = #{districtCode} AND sd.type = #{type} AND tsp.deleted = 0 AND sd.deleted = 0 AND sd.status = 0 GROUP BY tsd.name, sd.name, tsp.student_type

SELECT tsd.name AS districtName, sd.name AS deptName, COUNT(CASE WHEN latest_ppd.injection = 1 THEN 1 END) AS ppdNumber, COUNT(CASE WHEN latest_ppd.maxScreenOrder > 1 THEN 1 END) AS ppdReNumber, COUNT(CASE WHEN latest_ppd.outcome = 0 THEN 1 END) AS feminine, COUNT(CASE WHEN latest_ppd.outcome = 1 THEN 1 END) AS masculine FROM tb_screen_person AS tsp LEFT JOIN system_dept AS sd ON sd.id = tsp.dept_id LEFT JOIN tb_screen_district AS tsd ON tsd.CODE = sd.district_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT id_num, injection, outcome, screen_type, screen_order AS maxScreenOrder FROM tb_screen_ppd WHERE year = #{year} GROUP BY id_num, injection, outcome, screen_type, screen_order ORDER BY screen_order DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_ppd ON tsp.id_num = latest_ppd.id_num AND tsp.screen_type = latest_ppd.screen_type WHERE tsp.year = #{year} AND sd.district_code = #{districtCode} AND sd.type = #{type} AND tsp.deleted = 0 AND sd.deleted = 0 AND sd.status = 0 GROUP BY tsd.name, sd.name
